notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten Swamps.
description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {B} for each Swamp you control.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Onyx Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Cabal Coffers.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Repeat.
